mapper.sql: mp.id, mp.pool_code, mp.name, mp.logical_model_code, mp.selection_strategy, mp.status, mp.remark, mp.is_deleted, lm.model_name AS logical_model_name, lm.model_type AS model_type
from kb_model_pools mp left join kb_logical_models lm on lm.model_code = mp.logical_model_code and lm.is_deleted = 0
mapper.select:
select
and mp.is_deleted = 0
and ( mp.pool_code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or mp.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or mp.remark like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or lm.model_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
and lm.model_type in
#{type}
order by mp.is_deleted asc, mp.id desc

select count(1) from kb_model_pools where pool_code = #{poolCode}
and id != #{excludeId}
mapper.insert: insert into kb_model_pools(pool_code, name, logical_model_code, selection_strategy, status, remark) values(#{poolCode}, #{name}, #{logicalModelCode}, #{selectionStrategy}, #{status}, #{remark})
mapper.update: update kb_model_pools set pool_code = #{poolCode}, name = #{name}, logical_model_code = #{logicalModelCode}, selection_strategy = #{selectionStrategy}, status = #{status}, remark = #{remark} where id = #{id} and is_deleted = 0
mapper.delete: delete from kb_model_pools where id = #{id} and is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: select mpi.id, mpi.pool_code, mpi.model_code, mpi.weight, mpi.priority, mpi.status, m.model_code, (select lm2.model_name from kb_provider_model_mappings pm2 join kb_logical_models lm2 on lm2.model_code = pm2.logical_model_code where pm2.model_id = m.id and lm2.is_deleted = 0 order by pm2.id asc limit 1) as model_name, (select lm2.model_type from kb_provider_model_mappings pm2 join kb_logical_models lm2 on lm2.model_code = pm2.logical_model_code where pm2.model_id = m.id and lm2.is_deleted = 0 order by pm2.id asc limit 1) as model_type, m.provider_account_code, p.name as provider_name from kb_model_pool_items mpi inner join kb_models m on mpi.model_code = m.model_code left join kb_provider_accounts pa on m.provider_account_code = pa.code left join kb_providers p on pa.provider_code = p.code where mpi.pool_code = #{poolCode} order by mpi.priority asc, mpi.id asc
mapper.insert: insert into kb_model_pool_items(pool_code, model_code, weight, priority, status) values(#{poolCode}, #{modelCode}, #{weight}, #{priority}, #{status})
mapper.update: update kb_model_pools set is_deleted = 1 where id = #{id} and is_deleted = 0
update kb_model_pools set is_deleted = 0 where id = #{id} and is_deleted = 1
mapper.select: select count(1) from kb_routing_rule_targets where target_type = 'MODEL_POOL' and target_id = #{poolId}
